zh: 移动端升级为原生液态玻璃架构：支持 iOS 与 Android 双端原生渲染，重构 100% 全宽平滑手势侧栏与紧凑版式。
优化对话渲染与流式响应：新增实时打字机流式刷新机制，修复会话重入重绘，全面提升移动端交互流畅度。
登录与网络自适应增强：解决登录页非滚动专业布局与空白处轻触收起键盘，强化多节点容灾与快速建连能力。
en: Mobile apps upgraded to native liquid glass architecture with full-screen gesture sidebar and compact responsive layout on iOS and Android.
Real-time streaming and chat rendering improved: added instant typewriter streaming updates and view refresh reliability.
Login and network resilience enhanced: fixed non-scrollable native login page, dismiss keyboard on background tap, and smart multi-node failover.
